sources.title: Google Search Central — Spam policies for Google web search (thin affiliation, scaled content abuse)
sources.used_for: Thin-affiliation problem: affiliate pages with little original value beyond the links
sources.quote: Thin affiliation is the practice of publishing content with product affiliate links where the product descriptions and reviews are copied directly from the original merchant without any original content or added value. … Examples of good affiliate pages include offering additional information about price, original product reviews, rigorous testing and ratings, navigation of products or categories, and product comparisons.
sources.note: Quote and title corrected to the page's verbatim section text (session 28d2d6c0, T-23).

sources.title: Google Search Console Help — About Search Console
sources.used_for: What Search Console actually provides and therefore what the site is missing: search traffic data showing which queries surface the site and how often searchers click through. Basis for F-10, F-17, SG-07, SG-18, Q-07, Q-17 and Q-18.
sources.quote: View Google Search traffic data for your site: how often your site appears in Google Search, which search queries show your site, how often searchers click through for those queries, and more.

sources.title: The Open Graph protocol — required properties
sources.used_for: The four properties the protocol requires on every page (og:title, og:type, og:image, og:url) and the recommendation to carry og:image:alt when an image is specified. Basis for F-21, SG-16 and the A15 gate rule.
sources.quote: The four required properties for every page are: og:title … og:type … og:image … og:url … og:image:alt — A description of what is in the image (not a caption). If the page specifies an og:image it should specify og:image:alt.

sources.title: Meta for Developers — Sharing best practices
sources.used_for: What a share crawler needs in order to render a card, and the sharing-debugger step that F-21 and Q-21 still owe. Basis for SG-16, F-21, Q-21.
sources.quote: Use Open Graph meta tags to ensure the Facebook Crawler scrapes useful information, such as title, description, and preview image … Use the Sharing Debugger tool to test how your websites are viewed by our scraper … Use images that are at least 1080 pixels in width for best display on high resolution devices.
sources.note: Page states 'Updated: Feb 23, 2022'. It does not say JPG or PNG; the earlier to-verify wording in data/suggestions.json claimed it did, and that claim was corrected when the page was fetched.

sources.title: Google Search Console — about (product page)
sources.used_for: Search Console as the first-party source of query, impression and click data, and the owner-side verification step that stands between the site and any query data (SG-07, SG-18, Q-07, Q-18).
sources.quote: Optimize your content with Search Analytics: See which queries bring users to your site. Analyze your site's impressions, clicks, and position on Google Search.
